job_title: AI Developer
job_description:
Description

As an AI-First Developer on the R&D team, you will build AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems that help teams across the organization make better decisions. You will work with behavioral and operational data from over 30 million websites that use our products - WPForms, MonsterInsights, OptinMonster, Easy Digital Downloads, and more - and turn that data into analytics platforms, reporting automation, workflow intelligence, and AI-powered features that real teams use every day.

This is not a WordPress development role. WordPress familiarity is a bonus for product context, but the core of this role is AI/ML engineering on top of an extraordinary data asset. You will sit between a Full Stack AI Developer and an AI ML Engineer - strong enough on the ML and data side to work intelligently with large-scale operational data, and product-minded enough to build tools that teams actually adopt.

Interested in applying?

Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here's the type of person you are:

  • You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools - you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive.
  • You're a self-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next.
  • You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it.
  • You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project - from data exploration and model selection to building the API, deploying the service, and making sure it actually works in production.
  • You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down.
  • You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow your skills. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, not because someone tells you to.
  • You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work - clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path.
  • You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside other developers and doesn't take critical feedback personally.
  • You're excited about building internal tools and data systems that may not have a flashy frontend but have massive impact on how an organization operates.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Building AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems used across the organization - analytics platforms, reporting automation, workflow intelligence.
  • Developing AI/ML-driven platforms that process and analyze large-scale operational data from 30M+ sites across our product suite.
  • Designing and deploying RAG systems, LLM-powered features, and agentic workflows that generate actionable insights for internal teams.
  • Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale.
  • Prototyping and shipping AI solutions that streamline internal processes, reduce manual effort, and improve decision-making.
  • Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case - balancing performance, cost, and latency.
  • Writing clean, well-tested, production-grade Python code with proper error handling, logging, and observability.
  • Collaborating with product teams and stakeholders to understand what they need, then building tools they actually use.
  • Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team.
  • Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production environments (not just POCs or hackathon projects).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including production-grade practices - proper packaging, testing, type hints, async where appropriate.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks and tools: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch.
  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models.
  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals - not just API calls, but how models work, when to fine-tune vs prompt engineer, how to evaluate properly.
  • Experience building and deploying APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or similar) that serve ML models in production.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with data processing at scale - SQL, pandas, Spark, or similar.
  • Competent with version control through Git and GitHub. Clean commit history, proper branching, code review through PRs.
  • The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly without sacrificing code quality.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting skills - when something breaks in production at scale, you can diagnose it.
  • Ability to keep complex systems simple. Simplicity is a core value.
  • Previous remote work experience. You know how to manage your time, communicate proactively, and stay productive without supervision.
  • Personal computer with reliable internet access.
  • Availability to participate in audio/video meetings and be available on Slack between the hours of 9 AM - 1 PM EST daily.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Experience with model fine-tuning (PEFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and quantization techniques for cost optimization.
  • Experience building multi-agent systems using CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices - model versioning, drift monitoring, experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc).
  • Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms.
  • Published research, open-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding.
  • Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context.
  • Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non-technical teams rely on daily.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, structured output, or similar LLM integration patterns.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We're spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you'll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

Location

This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion Statement

At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?

If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Please clearly include the following in your cover letter:

  • A brief walkthrough of your AI/ML journey - where you started, what you've built, and what kind of work excites you most.
  • The most impactful AI system you've built in production. What did it do, who used it, and what made it hard?
  • If you had access to behavioral data from 30 million websites - form submissions, conversion flows, email engagement, plugin usage - what is the first thing you would build and why?
  • Profile links with code samples (GitHub, GitLab, personal repos, published packages, etc).
  • Links to any published research, technical blog posts, or open-source contributions.
  • Other profile links if available (your website, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, etc).
  • Tell us a bit about yourself and why you should be considered. Details about your experience, qualifications, personality, etc are very helpful.

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won't be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you're a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

job_title: AI Customer Support Specialist
job_description:
Please submit your CV in English.

🌍 Global AI calling platform · $35.3M raised
🚀 Structured mentorship & upskilling
📍 Prague — new office on Náměstí Republiky · 5 days in-office (occasional home office by agreement)
💰 Base 40,000–55,000 CZK gross/month + monthly bonus up to 20% (quality & CSAT)

💻 Working hours: two options/shifts:
- Mon–Fri: 08:00–16:30, or
- Mon–Fri: 14:00–22:30

The Challenge Ahead

Support at CloudTalk is changing. Most routine answers now come from our internal AI assistant — and you are the person who makes that assistant trustworthy.

This isn't a ticket-closing role. You run every customer conversation through our AI, judge whether its answer is right, sharpen it when it isn't, and take over the moment the AI reaches its limit. In practice, you're the senior reviewer the AI answers to: you supervise it, escalate past it, and teach it to do better next time.

That means your work compounds. A ticket solved well helps one customer. A correction fed back into the AI helps every customer after. We're looking for people who see that difference and want to work at that level.

If you like understanding how systems behave, spotting patterns across hundreds of conversations, and telling a genuinely good answer from a plausible-but-wrong one, this role is built for you.

No previous VOIP experience required — we'll teach you the fundamentals. What matters most is logic, curiosity, technical comfort, and judgment.

And here's the part most support jobs can't offer: this is a real way into a product company. You'll learn how AI works, how to make it better, and how a product company actually runs — from the inside.

What You’ll Do

  • Run an AI-first workflow. Use CloudTalk's internal AI assistant on every conversation — review, refine, and approve its answer before it reaches the customer. You own the final response, not the AI.
  • Train the AI. Catch where it's wrong, outdated, or missing context, and feed structured corrections back so it improves over time.
  • Find what's missing. Identify gaps in the knowledge base, tooling, and integrations that keep the AI from resolving issues on its own — and flag or fix them.
  • Be the escalation point. When the AI can't solve something, you take over: investigate call flows, connectivity problems, audio quality, device setups, and configuration errors.
  • Diagnose VOIP issues — latency, jitter, firewalls, ISP behaviours, and similar edge cases.
  • Dig into the data. Inspect logs, replicate issues, and gather the detail L2 and Product need for deeper analysis.
  • Build the knowledge base. Write and improve articles that train both customers and the AI — clear, accurate, reusable.
  • Spot patterns. Surface recurring issues and automation opportunities across the conversations you and the AI handle.
  • Shape how AI does support here. Contribute to the prompts, workflows, and guardrails as we make AI native to every conversation.



Who We’re Looking For

🧠 A logical thinker. You enjoy puzzles, find root causes, and structure your thinking clearly.

🛠 Tech-savvy and curious. System settings, connection tests, and logs don't intimidate you. You don't need to be an engineer — but you dig in.

🤖 AI-fluent, or eager to be. You're comfortable working alongside AI tools: prompting them well, reading their output critically, and knowing when to trust them and when not to. This is core to the role.

👁 A critical eye. You can tell a correct answer from a confident-sounding wrong one. Supervising an AI well depends on it.

⚡ A problem-solver with ownership. You measure success by problems solved, not ticket volume. Proactive, responsible, set on getting things right.

💬 A strong communicator. Clear English at C1. Spanish is a plus.

🤝 A team player who shares knowledge. Curiosity and collaboration are part of our culture — and a teammate who teaches also teaches the AI.

Why Join CloudTalk

🤖 Work at the front of AI support. Help build the human-plus-AI support model for a platform used by thousands of sales and support teams worldwide, from scale-ups to enterprise.

💡 Meaningful technical work. Learn real VOIP fundamentals — call routing, number provisioning, latency, connectivity troubleshooting, platform logic — and how to make an AI reason about all of it.

🚀 A launchpad, not a destination. Breaking into a fast-moving AI SaaS company usually means already having an engineering or product background. This role is the exception — a genuine entry point into demanding, high-judgment work. You'll learn how AI reasons, how to make it measurably better, and how product gets built. From here, people grow into:

  • Product — including roles like AI Product Builder, shaping the AI that powers the platform
  • Technical & AI — L3 Engineer, Technical Consultant, Integration Specialist, and support-automation and AI-quality roles
  • Customer-facing careers — Account Manager, Customer Implementations, and beyond
  • Operations — Shift Lead

The work compounds, and so does your career: this is the door into CloudTalk, and it opens onto almost everything.

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.

We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.

We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.

Hiring Process

  1. Quick video interview
  2. Role deep dive: meet your future colleagues
  3. Assignment: work a real scenario inside our platform and AI assistant
  4. Culture Bar Raiser call — explore your potential to raise the bar in adaptability, ownership, and continuous improvement
  5. 🎯 Offer

Company Benefits

Growth:

💡 1-1 Coaching sessions with our resident communications advisor
🤖  Everything you need to do your best work with AI—from AI Champions and office hours to our AI L&D Hub and dedicated Slack support.

Flexibility:

🏖 Unlimited Paid Time Off
🎗️ Volunteering Days
💻 MacBook for work

Well-being:

🏖Recharge Fridays once per quarter
🏋🏼‍♀️ Multisport Card

Connectedness:

💲 Referral bonuses
👥 Virtual & physical team buildings
👕 Company merchandise

job_title: Lifecycle & Growth Marketing Manager
job_description:
🌍 Global SaaS Scale-up | Series B
💡 Personalised 1:1 Coaching 
💰€3,300 - €4,200 gross/month (CZK 80k - 100k gross/month)

The Role

CloudTalk is building the next generation of AI-powered business communication. Our product is getting stronger every quarter. The gap we're closing now is the distance between a compelling product story and the conversion moment — the point where the right person, reading the right message at the right time, takes action.

This role owns that gap.

You will report directly to the Director of Product Marketing and work from CloudTalk's positioning and messaging as your source of truth. Your job is to translate strategy into copy, copy into campaigns, and campaigns into measurable funnel outcomes, and to do it with speed, structure, and a relentless focus on what actually moves the number.

The role operates on three tracks simultaneously.

The first is always-on: building and maintaining the conversion systems that compound over time — lifecycle campaigns, activation flows, onboarding sequences — monitoring their performance and raising the floor continuously.

The second is directional: when the company sets a step-change goal, you run the experiments and targeted fixes needed to reach that next level.

The third is launch activation: when PMM kicks off a product or feature launch, you are deployed to build the funnel structures that make it land — the campaigns, sequences, and conversion surfaces that turn launch momentum into measurable adoption and pipeline.

All three tracks can be live at the same time, and knowing how to balance them is part of the job

What You Will Own

Always-on conversion infrastructure

The lifecycle and activation systems running in the background — onboarding flows, trial nurture, re-engagement. You build them, monitor them on a regular cadence, and fix degradation before it becomes a problem. These are compounding assets: every improvement raises the baseline for good.

Directional experiments and growth pushes

When the company sets a step-change goal, you own the funnel strategy to hit it. Diagnose the friction blocking the goal, propose and build the interventions, and run structured experiments — moving fast from hypothesis to live test. Kill what fails, scale what works.

Launch activation

When PMM kicks off a launch, you're the conversion execution partner. PMM owns strategy, messaging, and project management; you own the funnel layer that makes it commercially successful — launch emails, in-app announcements, landing page variants, onboarding for new functionality, and post-launch adoption flows. Define the conversion goal up front (what success looks like at 7, 30, and 90 days), instrument it, and treat each launch as an experiment: set a baseline, run the plan, report what worked and what to change next time.

Automated campaign builds

Build and deploy lifecycle, trigger-based, and launch campaigns yourself — owning the setup, logic, segmentation, and QA of everything you ship. Keep the automation stack clean and documented so others can build on it.

Experimentation program

Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests across all three tracks. Stand up new engagement surfaces — a chat widget, an in-app tooltip series, a re-engagement sequence — as scoped experiments with defined success metrics. Document results rigorously: what you tested, learned, killed, and scaled.

Funnel diagnostics

Audit drop-off across the full journey — sign-up, activation, onboarding, expansion — on a rolling basis. Separate systemic issues (fix in the always-on layer) from acute friction (current growth push) and launch-specific gaps. Find the highest-leverage interventions and make the case for where to focus.

Compliance and list hygiene

Own GDPR consent and the cleanliness of the contact list, and govern who gets sent what. That means no unauthorized sends, keeping the list accurate and properly segmented, and owning the ability to send to all customers cleanly when needed (T&C updates and similar).

A note on copy: You don't need to be a professional copywriter, but you need to know what conversion copy looks like — enough to write a solid first draft, brief and direct an AI tool to produce variants, or work with a copywriter when the brief calls for it, and in every case tell the difference between copy that converts and copy that won't.

AI & Automation Mandate

This is not a nice-to-have. It is a core expectation of the role.

A significant portion of your time should be spent making yourself more effective through AI and automation — not as a productivity shortcut, but as a compounding investment. The goal is to build systems that reduce the cost of repetition, so your attention goes where judgment is actually required.

  • Audit your own workload. Anything you do more than twice in the same form — segmentation logic, copy variants, performance summaries, sequence drafts — is a candidate for automation. You decide whether to build it yourself or scope it with our AI team.
  • Build an automation stack you actually use. Not a collection of half-finished experiments but a working set of workflows that handles the repeatable parts of the job reliably.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier on experimentation. Generate copy variants at scale, synthesize results faster, pressure-test messaging against different audience segments before anything goes live.
  • Collaborate with our AI team. For automations beyond your solo capacity, scope the requirement, make the case, and follow through to implementation.
  • Document and share what works. When you build something that saves time or improves output, write it up. The goal is not personal efficiency alone — it is raising the floor for the whole team.

We don't want someone who uses AI. We want someone who builds with it, treats automation as part of their craft, and actively works to replace the repeatable parts of the job with systems.

How Success is Measured

You will be measured on outcomes, not outputs. Specific targets are set in alignment with company goals. The standing KPI framework is:

  • Funnel conversion lift — measurable improvement at defined stages (trial-to-paid %, feature activation within 14 days, booking rate from a given surface). Baseline set each focus period; target agreed with the Director of PMM.
  • Always-on system health — sustained performance of owned campaigns, with the floor rising quarter over quarter. Undiagnosed degradation is a miss.
  • Launch activation performance — conversion tied to each launch (adoption at 7/30/90 days, engagement, pipeline influence where relevant), against a goal set in advance.
  • Experiment velocity and win rate — tests shipped per period and the share that reach statistical significance.
  • Time-to-deploy — how fast a diagnosed problem or launch brief becomes a live campaign. Speed never replaces rigor, but sustained slowness signals something's broken.

Who You Are

  • You think like a strategist and work like a builder. You read a funnel, form a hypothesis about what's broken and why, then build the fix yourself — no waiting on a developer, designer, or ops handoff.
  • You're product-fluent. You understand what the product does, which features drive value for which users, and how that maps to funnel moments — and you use that to decide what to push, when, and to whom. Nobody has to tell you which product to promote.
  • You're data-literate, not data-dependent. Comfortable reading dashboards and funnel metrics, forming hypotheses from both numbers and qualitative signals (customer feedback, sales themes, support patterns). You know signal from noise, and when to ask for deeper analysis.
  • You have a builder's relationship with tools. You've lived inside automation platforms, CRMs, and no/low-code environments — building sequences and logic branches and troubleshooting breaks, not just configuring templates.
  • You operate on multiple tracks. Run a disciplined always-on system, push a directional goal, and pivot into launch mode — without dropping balls already in the air.
  • You know the difference between executing a launch and owning one. You're energized by being the conversion execution partner without needing to own the whole project.
  • You're good with words and know what converts. Not a professional copywriter, but able to write a competent first draft and tell what will move someone — whether you, an AI, or a copywriter wrote it.
  • You treat AI as a craft, not a shortcut. You've built workflows and automations from scratch, not just used off-the-shelf tools. You can point to specific things you built, explain why, and show what they changed.

Why You Will Love to be a CloudTalker:

🤖 AI Enablement: Everything you need to do your best work with AI—from AI Champions and office hours to our AI L&D Hub and dedicated Slack support

Flexibility:

🏖 Unlimited Paid Time Off (with guidelines)
🕣 Flexible Work Hours
🏡 Work from Home Allowance
🎗️ Volunteering Days
💻 MacBook for work 

Well-being:
🏖 Recharge Fridays once per quarter
🏋🏼‍♀️ Multisport Card

Connectedness:
💲 Referral bonuses
👥 Virtual & physical team buildings
👕 Company merchandise

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.

Job Description

The Head of Commercial is the head of Ikerian’s market footprint and global revenue growth. Your mission is to optimize a complex revenue mix spanning scalable clinical SaaS, bespoke research collaborations, and Data-Driven Intelligence solutions for the pharma and clinical segment. You will professionalize our commercial engine by ensuring operational excellence while bridging the gap between innovation and global demand. As a key leader within the company and the EssilorLuxottica ecosystem, you will orchestrate strategic partnerships and implement new commercial concepts across global distribution models to maximize corporate synergies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct and execute the commercial strategy for multiple revenue streams, balancing clinics sales with high-value life science and pharma services and bespoke research collaborations.
  • Orchestrate the expansion of data-driven intelligence solutions (including RWE and Candidate Identification), establishing high-value partnerships to deliver advanced clinical insights to the industry.
  • Partner with EssilorLuxottica leadership to execute group-wide commercial synergies, such as retail expansion and clinical distribution via the global affiliate network.
  • Leverage and empower internal subject matter expertise to deepen Key Opinion Leader (KOL) relationships and strategic partnerships, ensuring our commercial voice remains scientifically rigorous.
  • Institutionalize a data-driven sales methodology and modern workflows, defining a cadence and rhythm that is tracked through a commercial record to ensure scalable and professionalized growth.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to the commercial team to ensure a unified approach to revenue generation.
  • Professionalize the end-to-end commercial financial lifecycle by standardizing pricing tiers and commission structures while optimizing the quote-to-cash cycle to ensure all contracts are aligned with accurate resource costing and seamless invoicing.
  • Collaborate with the Research department to align market demand with project selection, establishing clear resource-allocation frameworks that balance immediate financial performance with long-term strategic R&D value.
  • Translate market intelligence and competitor trends into proactive commercial strategies, ensuring customer needs directly inform the technical roadmap and position Ikerian as a strategic partner to both pharma, clinics and clinical networks.
  • Transform Customer Operations into a value-driven "Success" engine that maximizes lifetime value (LTV) through renewals, expansions, and upselling.
  • Oversee brand strategy and marketing execution to ensure Ikerian remains a distinctive, top-of-mind leader at international conferences and digital channels.
  • Monitor and optimize company-wide revenue KPIs, delivering transparent reporting on ARR, project margins, and pipeline velocity to drive strategic decision-making.

Requirements

  • Degree in Business/STEM/Law (MBA/PhD preferred). Fluent English + a major European language (DE/IT/FR) preferred. Swiss/EU work authorization required.
  • Proven track record in scaling software solutions within the healthcare sector, with specific expertise in navigating the procurement and implementation cycles of pharma, large-scale hospital systems and clinical networks.
  • Demonstrated ability to design "Value-Exchange" business models, specifically regarding the use of software platforms to facilitate data acquisition and commercialization.
  • Strong background in consultative selling to Life Science stakeholders such as Big Pharma, with a record of closing large, long-cycle deals that require significant market education.
